name: python-counting-sort
title: Counting Minimum Spanning Tree
blurb: stable counting sort over small nonneg integer arrays: the sorted list equals the shipped oracle (sorted()) on every seeded corpus, equal keys keep their input order, the tally is the histogram, and the rank is its prefix; negative or oversized values are named, never sorted.
default_description: A spanning-tree walker whose total is the enumeration oracle's minimum on every small undirected graph, whose witness ledger tells the truth, and whose tree spans every node exactly once.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: the tally is the histogram and the order is the prefix sum
